name: hud_ui_message_box_dialog_run_modal
description: HudUiMessageBoxDialog::RunModal switches rendering to the dialog blit rectangle, enables the modal dialog, updates until the modal result/countdown ends, then restores HUD/video render state.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x4bf630 yet; current evidence is functional only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation at 0x4bf630 validates the half-res/invalidate transition, active render-region save/restore, software/primary surface selection, text assignment, OK button reveal, modal update loop, primary unlock/present calls, and return of modalResult.

The native message-box RunModal smoke installs a one-frame dialog update dispatch and verifies result/countdown behavior, text assignment, OK button visibility, primary unlock dispatch, and final zRndr region restoration.
